subject: POC environment action compact: API keys, org setup, allowlist & peering
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@asterlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@asterlabs.com>
Date: 2025-08-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff + technical MAP for AsterLabs POC

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited. We want to lock in a short mutual action plan so our engineering team can validate latency and end-to-end behavior this month. High level asks from our side:

- Org setup (tenant + team roles)
- API keys and scoped credentials for staging POC
- IP allowlist range for our egress (we will also share VPC peering desire)
- Preliminary uptime and throughput expectations for the trial 2-node workload

Can you propose a compact MAP with owners and a timeline? We aim for environment-ready in ~7 business days. I attached a quick spreadsheet with our preferred dates (asterlabs-map-v1.xlsx).

Also copying Samir (infra) — he’ll own the peering side.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Product Lead, AsterLabs
attachments: asterlabs-map-v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@asterlabs.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@asterlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + technical MAP for AsterLabs POC

Priya — great to hear. Proposal below is intentionally compact and focused on the POC handoff items you listed. Owners are Redwood | AsterLabs.

1) Org & Roles (owner: Sofia / Marissa) — by 2025-09-02
   - Create AsterLabs tenant in Redwood console
   - Assign dev/test roles to Samir + 2 engineers

2) API Keys (owner: Marissa) — by 2025-08-31
   - Issue scoped staging API keys (read/write limited to test models)
   - Provide credential template (redwood-credentials-template.txt)

3) IP Allowlist (owner: AsterLabs / Karthik) — by 2025-09-02
   - AsterLabs provides egress IP range; Redwood confirms CIDR and whitelists
   - If peering is desired, exchange VPC CIDR + routing plan

4) VPC peering (owner: Samir / Karthik) — target window 2025-09-03 to 2025-09-05
   - Initial validation via test instance; fall back to API-based integration if peering delayed

5) Acceptance & close (owner: Priya / Sofia) — acceptance criteria: successful 10K token/day run at <200ms p50 for generation path; basic eval suite pass

I’ve attached the credential template and a one-line MAP we can import to HubSpot. Can Marissa generate the keys and post them to the secure Drive link? Samir, please share the CIDR you want whitelisted.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync if that helps.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-credentials-template.txt (txt)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@asterlabs.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@asterlabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-29T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + technical MAP for AsterLabs POC

Looping in operational details — I’ll own key issuance and token scoping. Quick checklist from my side:

- Staging API keys will be created with:
  * model_access: [gpt-family-staging]
  * org_scope: asterlabs-staging
  * rate_limit: 200 r/s burst 500 (can tune)
- Keys will be uploaded to the secure Drive folder and a access note posted to HubSpot under the deal record.
- I will not email raw keys; we will share via the Drive link with link expiration and access audit.

Target: create keys 2025-08-31 and add to Drive.

Karthik — can you confirm the allowlist workflow and whether you need a ticket or direct CIDR to push to our edge? If Samir wants to peer, we’ll need the VPC routing table and a pre-shared ASN.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@asterlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@asterlabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + technical MAP for AsterLabs POC

Thanks — couple of clarifying questions from infra: 

1) For IP allowlist: we will provide two CIDR blocks (10.40.0.0/18 and 52.14.128.0/26). Does Redwood require a single consolidated CIDR or can you add both?
2) For VPC peering: our infra team needs the Redwood-powered VPC ASN and the expected BGP setup. Is peering BGP or static route based on your deployment model?

We’d prefer peering but can fall back to allowlist if getting peering approved internally will take longer than your 2025-09-03 window.

Samir
Samir Patel
Infra Lead, AsterLabs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@asterlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@asterlabs.com>
Date: 2025-09-02T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + technical MAP for AsterLabs POC

Samir — we can accept multiple CIDR ranges, please provide both and we will add them to the edge allowlist. For peering: Redwood supports two modes depending on customer environment — BGP peering with optional ASN exchange (preferred for full routing) or static-routes peering for restricted paths. For the short trial I recommend:

- If you can approve BGP quickly, we’ll run BGP peering (pre-shared ASN: redwood-asn 64512) and exchange routes. This gives the cleanest path and fewer NAT issues.
- Otherwise, provide the CIDRs and we’ll configure static routes on our side for the POC.

Action items updated:
- Marissa: create keys by 2025-08-31 (pending)
- Priya / Samir: confirm CIDRs or sign off for BGP by 2025-09-02 (Pending)
- Sofia: schedule a 30-min test-run for 2025-09-04 to validate token throughput and p50 latency; fallback to 2025-09-07 if peering delayed

I’ll push a short note into the HubSpot deal with these action items and link the Drive folder. Let me know if you want a Zoom now.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Network Engineer | Redwood Inference
